text: The activated sample (0.7261 g) was packed into a stainless‐steel column with an inner diameter of 4 mm and a length of 105 mm. The outlet effluent from the column was continuously monitored by a mass spectrometer (Hidden QGA quantitative gas analysis S3 system). The column packed with activated sample was first purged with a helium gas flow (8 mL/min) for 12 h at 120°C. During the breakthrough process, the gas mixture flow rate was 2 mL/min. The breakthrough experiments were conducted at 298 K and 1 bar.
